demo.cliff: three fields are stored and three are derived from the grade
teaches: grade is the whole of what a passage is: high, middle, basic, low or working.
count is how many are booked on this ticket, and farePerHead what one of them paid.
The berth, the baggage allowance and whether it is a low berth all follow from the grade, so no document writes them.
demo.trap: Do not author baggage, fare or lowBerth — they are derived from the grade and a value written beside them is either ignored or fights the derivation. destination.world is left empty on purpose: a cross-Actor UUID does not survive a single drag out of a compendium, so destination.name carries the fact instead.

system.description: Two berths out of Bellweather on the next courier, paid in advance and no questions on the manifest.
